name: Oakland I
summary: The original Raiders era: the franchise launched in 1960, established itself in Oakland, became an AFL power, and won its first two Super Bowls before relocating to Los Angeles after the 1981 season.

name: Los Angeles
summary: The Raiders played in Los Angeles from 1982 through 1994, winning Super Bowl XVIII and building a distinct Southern California chapter around the Los Angeles Memorial Coliseum.

name: Oakland II
summary: The Raiders returned to Oakland in 1995 and remained there through the 2019 season, including the 2002 AFC championship run and a final generation of Coliseum history.

name: Las Vegas
summary: The Las Vegas era began in 2020 with Allegiant Stadium as the franchise's new home and continues as the current chapter of Raiders history.
